name: cargo
why: Rust toolchain — builds and tests the Rust workspaces (clavity-classic, ghidrust; each pinned via its own rust-toolchain.toml).

name: cargo-nextest
why: Primary test runner — faster and clearer than `cargo test`, used for the ghidrust integration suite.

name: cargo-deny
why: Supply-chain gate — license, security-advisory, and dependency-ban checks (deny.toml).

name: just
why: Cross-platform task runner — recipes for fetch-Ghidra, run-integration, release orchestration.

name: lefthook
why: Git hooks — fast gate (fmt/clippy/unit) pre-commit, full gate (integration) pre-push.
install: cargo install lefthook  (or: winget install evilmartians.lefthook)

name: java (JDK 21)
why: Ghidra 12.1.2 runtime dependency — the headless worker JVM. Must be JDK 21 (application.java.min=21).

name: Ghidra 12.1.2
why: The reverse-engineering engine ghidrust's worker drives via analyzeHeadless. Located by GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR.

name: npx (Node) — MCP Inspector
why: Dev-only: manual tool-surface harness (`npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector`) to test tools/schemas without an agent. Not a runtime dependency.

name: ISCC (Inno Setup Compiler)
why: compile + smoke-test a product installer .iss (clavity-dotnet, clavity-classic, ghidrust) locally instead of via remote release CI

name: uv
why: Python bridge lockfile tool — check-versions.ps1 gates uv.lock via `uv lock --check`, and `just bump classic` runs `uv lock`. Also the installer's bridge-install runtime.

name: cargo-edit
why: Provides `cargo set-version`, used by `just bump` to move Cargo.toml + Cargo.lock in one step (classic + ghidrust binary). CI reads via `cargo metadata` and does NOT need this.

name: Pester
why: runs scripts/tests/*.Tests.ps1 for the drain gates. v6 line - PIN THE MAJOR: an unpinned install follows the newest major, and CI pins 6.x to match. Needs PowerShell 5.1 or 7.4+.

name: mlc
why: Markup link checker (becheran/mlc) - validates every relative link across the 46 in-scope docs. Config: .mlc.toml (offline, product docs only). Run: just check-links.

name: awk
why: Read the per-driver status columns in agy-autotrain/verify/assertions.md. The SessionStart verify gate nags when awk is absent rather than failing silent, so a missing awk is visible but blocking.
install: Ships with Git for Windows (/usr/bin/awk); otherwise: winget install GnuWin32.Gawk
